title: E8 low-read bit with seven-stage complex supplier
body:
κ = 9.04569597143250e-4

This new, immutable package records

`κ = 3618278388573 / 4000000000000000 = 9.04569597143250e-4`.

It improves the pinned PR370 E8 value `8.75481145306751e-4` by changing only the commuting B-stage chain schedule. The exact five-stage moment profile is
`c = 905388584776183 / 10^18 = 9.05388584776183e-4`; the fresh PR363 seven-stage complex supplier is
`b3 = 932783231884153 / 10^18 = 9.32783231884153e-4`, so the bit side binds.

The package is at `research/e8-low-read-seven-complex` and is self-verifying:

```text
cd research/e8-low-read-seven-complex
python3 -B verify.py
```

Verification and provenance include:

- `h=8`, `v=120`, `R=865`, `m=40`, `W=1345`, nine retained centres; 22,020 paid calls, rank mass 53,680, and deficit 120.
- The low-read schedule has 306 target reads, down from 352; D/A/C fields, frames, retained totals, scatter, endpoints, and the scalar B transvection multiset are unchanged from PR370.
- The exact finite invoice coefficient is `1916288151501` (41 bits), the row bounds are `742/6308`, and the exact 47-constraint assembly plus adjacent `10^-18` grid rejection pass for the displayed κ.
- Two fresh complete replays of this exact candidate package passed with observed outer exit 0: CPython 3.12 session 67975 and CPython 3.11 session 31552. Fresh PR363 supplier replays also passed with observed exit 0 (CPython 3.12 session 40111; CPython 3.11 session 79936).
- The signed defining-source supplement negates only D and C compensation phases. Its F2 projection is byte-identical to the candidate raw word and it restores all 1,105 source/helper columns over Z for arbitrary helper dirt. The clean target decoder has `M mod 2 = I`, diagonal coefficients `[1,3,5]`, max coefficient 8, and 14,400 nonzero coefficients.
- Forward, reflected/inverse, and reverse-source ledgers pass with histogram `{1:2096,2:930,3:454,4:390,5:308,6:2,7:14,8:18}`; both directions have 4,212 paid calls and rank mass 8,672.
- Every one of 4,203 paid MOVE occurrences links to an exact rational E8 projector chart. All 944 used frames are positive-definite under `<x,y>/2`; 3,334 distinct move/copy gaps, both reflected gaps, exact chart inverses, 865 width-40 banks, and bank omission controls pass. The renamed five-stage program contains 96,085 records.

The complex seven-stage package retains PR363's stated conditional obligations, including its seven-stage bridge/Lean limitations. The inherited all-size compiler, source527 decoder theorem, analytic transfer, and exact theorem remain outside this finite witness. No seven-stage bit estimate is used.

Provenance and attribution are preserved in `NOTICE.md` and `provenance/`: PR370 is attributed to Dylan Crow with Anthropic Claude; PR363 to DaysSky with Claude; the E8 unit to Jacob Sussman; and the low-read schedule, signed repair, audits, and this package to OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing Apache-2.0 notices are retained.
